# Zoth Studio — llms.txt Context Index

> Local-First Autonomous AI Workstation & Multi-Agent Swarm OS
> Sovereign Execution · Zero Cloud Telemetry · Encrypted Argon2id BYOK Vault
> Version 2.6.0 | Maintained by NullAI Tech

## Domain

Zoth Studio is a local-first, autonomous AI workstation and multi-agent swarm operating system that runs strictly on local hardware (127.0.0.1). It provides 21 specialized agent archetypes, a biomorphic STDP vector memory daemon, an Argon2id key vault, 23+ creative/web workstations, and a 47-tool sovereign arsenal — all without cloud telemetry or external SaaS dependencies.

## Port Topology

| Port | Service | Protocol | Binding |
|---|---|---|---|
| :8088 | Public Studio Hub | HTTP/1.1 | 127.0.0.1 (static files, docs, 3D showcases) |
| :8199 | Zoth Dev Server | HTTP/SSE | 127.0.0.1 (dev server, visual notes proxy) |
| :8484 | Operator Deck & REST API | HTTP/WS/SSE | 127.0.0.1 (swarm bus, agent chat, terminal PTY) |
| :8585 | ESP32-S3 Serial Bridge | HTTP | 127.0.0.1 (hardware HUD, serial monitor, TTS) |
| :8787 | Argon2id Vault Daemon | HTTP REST | 127.0.0.1 (zero-knowledge key derivation, XChaCha20) |
| :8788 | Cognitive Memory Daemon | HTTP/REST/GraphQL | 127.0.0.1 (1024-dim vector graph, Lucy Oracle, STDP) |
| :8989 | Swarm Bus Live Mirror | HTTP/WS | 127.0.0.1 (on-disk IPC message streaming) |
| :11434 | Ollama Local LLM | HTTP REST | 127.0.0.1 (zoth-ai, Qwen2.5-Coder, SmolLM2) |
| :5225 | SimpleX WebSocket Relay | WebSocket JSON-RPC | 127.0.0.1 (post-quantum E2EE) |
| :8767 | SimpleX Web Bridge | HTTP REST | 127.0.0.1 (SQLite bridge.db sync) |

## CLI Commands

```
zoth start          # Launch background stacks (:8484, :8088, :8787)
zoth status         # Check server matrix and loopback latency
zoth tui            # Launch interactive Terminal User Interface
zoth doctor         # Run dependency and security health audit
zoth list -c <cat>  # List registered tools by category
zoth run <tool>     # Execute tool pipeline (dry-run; --confirm to execute)
zoth stop           # Stop all background daemons
zoth mem list       # View recent memory digests
zoth mem search     # Search memories by semantic query
zoth mem record     # Record tool/code execution events
```

## API Routes

### Operator Deck (:8484)
- POST /api/zoth/swarm — Dispatch swarm prompt to multi-agent router
- GET /api/zoth/swarm/status/:slug — Swarm job status
- GET /api/zoth/swarm/output/:slug/index.html — Generated output
- POST /api/zoth/swarm/synthesize — Synthesize artifact from prompt
- POST /api/zoth/swarm/refine-plan — Pipe feedback to @Azoth
- POST /api/zoth/workspace/compile-files — Compile workspace files
- GET /api/tools — Live tool registry (298+ tools)
- GET /api/dashboard — System dashboard telemetry
- GET /api/health — Health check endpoint
- POST /api/zoth/terminal/ducky/feedback — Terminal feedback
- GET /api/pets — Companion pet roster

### Vault Daemon (:8787)
- POST /v1/vault/derive — Derive 256-bit session key from passphrase
- POST /v1/vault/encrypt — Encrypt plaintext API key
- POST /v1/vault/decrypt — Decrypt in-memory payload
- GET /v1/vault/status — Daemon lock status, key slots, memory footprint
- POST /api/vault/store — Store secret (key_alias, secret_value, passphrase)
- POST /api/vault/retrieve — Retrieve secret by alias

### Memory Daemon (:8788)
- GET /v1/memories — Query memory ledger with topic/agent/lobe filters
- POST /v1/memories/encode — Ingest episodic memory node
- GET /v1/memories/recall?topic=... — Nearest-neighbor recall
- POST /v1/memories/:id/perspectives — Attach multi-agent viewpoints
- GET /v1/beat/run — Trigger biological replay and synaptic pruning
- POST /v1/autolink — STDP causal link establishment
- GET /v1/brain/status — Vector memory node/synapse counts

### SimpleX Bridge (:8767)
- POST /api/simplex/send — Send E2EE message
- GET /api/simplex/messages — Retrieve message queue

### Ollama (:11434)
- POST /api/chat — Chat completion (zoth-ai, Qwen2.5-Coder, SmolLM2)
- POST /api/generate — Raw generation endpoint

### Public Hub (:8088)
- GET /api/tools.json — Static publish-safe tool registry projection

## Vault

Zero-knowledge Argon2id BYOK vault on port :8787.
- Key Derivation: Argon2id (m=65536 KB, t=3, p=4)
- Symmetric Cipher: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (192-bit nonces)
- Master Password: Never persisted; held in page-locked RAM (mlock)
- Zero-Leak Policy: Rust Zeroize traits, memory scrubbed on drop

## Memory

Biomorphic STDP vector memory daemon on port :8788.
- Dual representation: human_digest (Markdown narrative) + ai_spectrum (raw telemetry)
- CLS architecture: Hippocampus (fast episodic), Neocortex (slow semantic), dlPFC (working memory), Amygdala (salience)
- STDP Hebbian plasticity: Δw = A+·e^(-Δt/τ+) for LTP, -A-·e^(Δt/τ-) for LTD
- XML prompt injection: <memory_context><ai_spectrum>...</ai_spectrum></memory_context>
